acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: LaunchDarkly ld-find-code-refs https://github.com/launchdarkly/ld-find-code-refs .

Gap: AMAP-V0-006 records the flags on each screen but does not use them for impact or coverage.

Proposal: map a changed flag key or default to its gated screens and then to tests. Report flag variants that no test exercises, and flag references that have gone extinct. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: feature-flag change impact, untested variants and extinct flag references
